changes: Inspection ordering is now TC-mediated: buyer/seller inspection orders route to Nate (the TC) to place with the vendor, never sent directly to the vendor.
Brothers Group is now the ordering/paying party on inspection orders — client pays Brothers Group's Relay account by wire first, Nate places the vendor order only after payment is confirmed.
On order acceptance, client now receives a branded wiring-instructions email (with PDF attachment) instead of a generic 'we're scheduling this' message.
On order acceptance, Nate now receives a HOLD email (do not place vendor order until payment is confirmed) instead of the old accepted-notification.
New: notifyTCPaymentReceivedForInspectionOrder — fires when a wire payment reconciles an inspection_order, telling Nate to place the order with the vendor.
Jason Brown deactivated as an inspection vendor — Pro-Spect Inspection Services is now the sole preferred vendor.
Client-facing copy updated (InspectionOrderPage approved state + disclosure, InspectionsPricingPanel OrdersPanel description) to reflect Brothers Group as ordering/paying party.
New static mount /inspection-wiring for generated wiring-instruction PDFs (mirrors /repair-quotes pattern).
